args.task_description: 实现 issue-73-ubuntu 功能：Issue #73 Ubuntu sandbox isolation. Add the smallest Ubuntu-only, fail-closed local execution sandbox after existing LocalAdmission and ExecPolicy approval but before child execution. Deny filesystem escape outside the approved workspace and deny network capability unless explicitly approved by the existing capability/policy contract; never silently run unsandboxed if the Linux isolation primitive is unavailable. Preserve process-tree cancellation, bounded I/O, existing PTY/non-PTY behavior and Windows semantics. Do not implement Windows sandbox, Hooks, worktrees, snapshots, cloud authority, UI or packaging here. Require pinned GitNexus pre-edit impact for exact process/policy symbols, staged detect, Ubuntu 24.04 workspace-escape/symlink/network/cancellation/process-tree tests, Windows no-change regression, exact hashes and minimal rollback.
